title: Show the account as Pro to remove the Free-plan banner
description: Builds on 0002: sets plan to `pro` in the same relay-usage store. The always-on 'Use more computers at once with Pro' banner and the Free plan card's Upgrade button disappear; the plan row says Pro. The relay still reports the real plan and meters; this is client display only.
notes: Default. Makes Settings say Pro even though the relay still has the account on Free; the relay's counters and server-side enforcement are unchanged.
